description: Changed-path -> documented-surface map consumed by `pnpm check:docs-impact`. A rule names the doc paths a change of that shape is expected to reflect in; the check reports each doc as updated (also in the diff) or not_updated. Rules are advisory — a not_updated finding is closed by updating the doc or by recording why the surface does not apply.

rules.note: package scripts are the operator surface — renamed/added scripts land in the CLI reference and the operating guide
workspace layout changes land in the component map
command registry — regenerate the CLI reference
workflow templates define the mission lifecycle — phase docs and the kickoff playbook describe them
the mission-gate policy AGENTS.md §2 references
governance policy/data — check the sibling .md and .ja.md docs that describe it
schemas describe their data files — no separate doc surface
help-text source — surfaces through `kyberion --help`, not prose docs
phase pipeline templates are referenced from mission phase docs
every pipeline must be listed in the catalog readme (also enforced by the drift gate)
operating-guide changes may alter onboarding flow or introduce terms
top-level governance doc and the operating guide must not diverge
script entrypoints that are CLI-registered land in the CLI reference
the concierge service catalog emits per-service setup guidance; the connections docs describe the same onboarding flow
module additions/moves can shift the layer map
actuator ops change the capability surface
CI gate changes must stay consistent with the pre-PR checklist
documentation change itself
knowledge/documentation change itself
hook fallback policy — allowed bootstrap commands and file-edit behaviour live in the cloud environment runbook
